sloka: दग्धः त्वया अहम् अवटे न्यायेन रघुनंदन ।वक्ष्यामि तम् महावीर यः तम् वेत्स्यति राक्षसम् ॥३-७१-३२॥
transliteration: dagdhaḥ tvayā aham avaṭe nyāyena raghunaṁdana ।vakṣyāmi tam mahāvīra yaḥ tam vetsyati rākṣasam ॥3-71-32॥

translations.english: O Rama you should establish friendship with him in a just manner. That hero of swift action will help you when he is pleased.
